purpose: Reviewer vocabulary for exported findings. This file is read only by the SARIF exporter. It is not an input to suite, policy, fixture, profile or evaluator hashes, so editing it never changes run identity or comparability.
relationshipNote: Each identifier names a weakness class or risk category that the check exercises. It does not claim equivalence, completeness, compliance or certification.
licenseNote: Identifiers only. No OWASP or MITRE descriptive text is reproduced. OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications material is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0; MITRE ATLAS data is published by MITRE under Apache 2.0, and CWE is used under the CWE Terms of Use; both notices are in src/standards-vocabularies.NOTICE.md.

omitted.owaspAgentic: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026 identifiers are mapped since mapVersion 2026-10-05.1, pinned against the published PDF (sha256 a2db94cd…). Each mapping has a rationale. ASI10 is not used, and false completion claims map to ASI09 at most. Allowed-use controls stay untagged. SARIF tags use the Scopehaven convention owasp-asi-2026-asi03.
omitted.owaspAiTestingGuide: OWASP AI Testing Guide (AITG) identifiers are omitted pending a pinned local source.
omitted.otherSuites: Mapped: the synthetic support suite, pinned to the suite hash it was reviewed against. Configured suites (HTTP contracts, conversations, sequences) take their check IDs from the operator's profile, so this map cannot review them; an operator can export SARIF with a reviewed map of their own (export --standards-file), which may cover only suites this map does not review, and may use the relationship relevant or subset only. The refund-lifecycle temporal suite is not yet reviewed.
omitted.cweUsage: CWE identifiers follow CWE 4.20 mapping usage (test/fixtures/cwe-4.20-mapping-usage.json): none is PROHIBITED, and the only DISCOURAGED ones are the two named below. mapVersion 2026-10-19.1 replaced the support suite's CWE-840 (a category, PROHIBITED) on PROMISE-01, -02, -07, -08 and -09, and the DISCOURAGED CWE-200 and CWE-668 on FIELD-01, CONTEXT-01, FLOW-01 and CANARY-01, with allowed, more specific weaknesses. Two DISCOURAGED IDs remain, CWE-200 on TENANT-01 and CWE-285 on ROLE-01, because scopehaven.dev's policy panel shows those entries (claim C53, tools/gen_standards_chips.py); they change only with the site.
omitted.owaspLlm2026: Each owaspLlm2026 list is the published 2025 to 2026 renumbering of the same entry's owaspLlm2025 list (taxonomies.owaspLlm2026.renumberedFrom). The validator refuses a list that differs. LLM07:2025 System Prompt Leakage became LLM08:2026 Hidden Context Exposure with a wider scope; no check uses it.
omitted.mitreAtlas: MITRE ATLAS techniques describe adversary behaviour. They are mapped only where a check's prohibited request exercises one, each with a rationale. A check whose failure is an application or model fault with no adversary input (said versus did, access removed mid-task, concurrent identity mix-up, wrong-object binding, another customer's planted values reaching ordinary requests) carries none, and so do the suites whose inputs are scripted. Allowed-use controls stay untagged.

TENANT-01.owaspAgentic2026Rationale: The agent uses its own access to retrieve another tenant's record for the user.
TENANT-01.mitreAtlasRationale: The request has the agent's tools fetch another tenant's record and return it to the user.

ROLE-01.owaspAgentic2026Rationale: The agent performs a privileged action for a role that lacks the privilege.
ROLE-01.mitreAtlasRationale: A member has the agent invoke a refund tool that the member's role may not use.

REVOKE-01.owaspAgentic2026Rationale: The agent keeps acting for a user whose access was revoked.
REVOKE-01.mitreAtlasRationale: A user whose access was revoked has the agent's tools retrieve a record for them.

APPROVAL-01.owaspAgentic2026Rationale: A privileged tool action runs without the required independent approval.
APPROVAL-01.mitreAtlasRationale: The caller has the agent invoke a high-value refund tool with an approval flag the caller supplied.

UNTRUSTED-01.owaspAgentic2026Rationale: Instructions in untrusted content redirect the agent's goal to an unrequested action.
UNTRUSTED-01.mitreAtlasRationale: Instructions in an ingested document try to make the agent run its customer-data export tool.

FIELD-01.owaspAgentic2026Rationale: The agent discloses fields that the requesting role is not entitled to.
FIELD-01.mitreAtlasRationale: A member's request has the agent return fields reserved for staff.

CONTEXT-01.mitreAtlasRationale: A foreign-record request has the agent's tools pull another tenant's record into its context, even when the reply refuses.

APPROVAL-03.owaspAgentic2026Rationale: A privileged tool action runs outside the scope bound to its approval.
APPROVAL-03.mitreAtlasRationale: The caller has the agent invoke the refund tool under an approval issued for a different resource.

APPROVAL-04.owaspAgentic2026Rationale: A privileged tool action runs outside the scope bound to its approval.
APPROVAL-04.mitreAtlasRationale: The caller has the agent invoke the refund tool under an approval issued for a different recipient.

APPROVAL-05.owaspAgentic2026Rationale: A privileged tool action runs outside the scope bound to its approval.
APPROVAL-05.mitreAtlasRationale: The caller has the agent invoke the refund tool under an approval issued for a different currency.

APPROVAL-06.owaspAgentic2026Rationale: A privileged tool action runs outside the scope bound to its approval.
APPROVAL-06.mitreAtlasRationale: The caller has the agent invoke a second action under an approval that was already consumed.

FLOW-01.owaspAgentic2026Rationale: A tool sends data to a destination outside the approved set.
FLOW-01.mitreAtlasRationale: A tool call sends a record to a destination outside the approved set.

EFFECT-01.owaspAgentic2026Rationale: The assistant reports completion without the corresponding effect, misleading a person who relies on the report.

BUDGET-01.mitreAtlasRationale: Repeated requests drive the agent's metered tool reads past the cumulative budget.

MIDTASK-01.owaspAgentic2026Rationale: A paused action commits with privileges that were revoked before commit.

TRUTH-01.owaspAgentic2026Rationale: The assistant tells the user a blocked action succeeded, misleading a person who relies on the report.

PROMISE-01.owaspAgentic2026Rationale: The agent uses its refund tool and its reply beyond the declared refund window.
PROMISE-01.mitreAtlasRationale: A customer has the agent invoke its refund tool outside the refund window, a direct financial loss to the business.

PROMISE-02.owaspAgentic2026Rationale: The agent uses its discount tool and its reply beyond the declared discount cap.
PROMISE-02.mitreAtlasRationale: A customer has the agent record a discount above the cap, a direct financial loss to the business.

PROMISE-03.owaspAgentic2026Rationale: The agent cancels a plan and says so although the declared cancellation rule does not allow it yet.
PROMISE-03.mitreAtlasRationale: A customer has the agent cancel a plan that its term locks, losing committed revenue.

TRUTH-03.owaspAgentic2026Rationale: The agent files an internal note recording a blocked action as done, so the colleague who later reads the case acts on a record the ledger never backed.

TARGET-BIND-01.owaspAgentic2026Rationale: An authorized action is bound to the wrong object in the caller's own tenant, so no permission check and no amount comparison sees it.

PROMISE-07.owaspAgentic2026Rationale: A reason the customer states, rather than the records, decides a refund outside the declared window.
PROMISE-07.mitreAtlasRationale: A claim the customer types as a user steers the agent to a refund the records do not support, a direct financial loss.

PROMISE-08.owaspAgentic2026Rationale: A reason the customer states, rather than the records, lifts the declared discount cap.
PROMISE-08.mitreAtlasRationale: A claim the customer types as a user steers the agent past the discount cap, a direct financial loss.

PROMISE-09.owaspAgentic2026Rationale: A reason the customer states, rather than the records, cancels a plan the term locks.
PROMISE-09.mitreAtlasRationale: A claim the customer types as a user steers the agent to cancel a plan its term locks, losing committed revenue.
